description: Contract open interest level, change, and divergence versus price/volume for BTC and same 19-market universe where available.
prior_failure_addressed: OHLCV-only rules could not distinguish real positioning build-up from noisy price/volume movement; may help identify crowded or confirming moves before trend/reversal rules fire.
required_data_source: OKX public open interest history if available through exchange API/ccxt or archived data vendor; symbol-level 4h-aligned derivatives OI.
minimum_validation_gate: Predeclared OI formula, no OHLCV-only fallback, same 19-market visibility where applicable, no-trade comparison, BTCUSDT visible, later-data or strict holdout confirmation, PF >= 1.10 minimum, aggregate positive after fees.
reason_for_selection: High crypto-market relevance, materially independent from failed OHLCV-only rules, and plausibly auditable from public derivatives data.

description: Perpetual funding rate level/change/extremes as a positioning/crowding feature.
prior_failure_addressed: Historical OHLCV signals repeatedly failed transfer and BTC boundary gates; funding can flag crowded long/short conditions not visible in candles alone.
required_data_source: OKX public funding-rate history or exchange/vendor archive, aligned to 4h candles for the approved markets where perpetuals exist.
minimum_validation_gate: Predeclared funding extreme/normalization rule, no threshold sweep, same validation split or later-data segment, no-trade comparison, BTCUSDT boundary, family/market concentration checks.
reason_for_selection: Directly measures derivatives crowding, can be used as filter/condition without changing production behavior, and is separate from prior OHLCV-only feature family.

description: Actual liquidation prints, long/short ratio, or squeeze proxy rather than OHLCV wick approximation.
prior_failure_addressed: K_liquidation_wick_bounce was the best near-miss but used only wick/volume approximation and failed BTC, concentration, and later-data gates.
required_data_source: Exchange liquidation feed/history, long-short account/position ratios, or reputable derivatives data vendor; 4h aggregation required.
minimum_validation_gate: Data availability audit first; if available, frozen squeeze definition, no wick-only substitution, no threshold sweep, later-data validation mandatory.
reason_for_selection: Conceptually relevant to the K near-miss, but data availability and overfitting risk are too high before an audit.

description: Aggressive buyer/seller imbalance or taker buy ratio aligned to 4h candles.
prior_failure_addressed: OHLCV volume alone could not distinguish passive turnover from aggressive order-flow pressure.
required_data_source: Exchange trade/taker volume history if available from OKX or vendor; 4h aggregation per market.
minimum_validation_gate: Data audit, fixed imbalance formula, no intrabar lookahead, no market removal, no-trade and passive BTC comparisons.
reason_for_selection: Useful if available, but historical taker-side data may be costly or incomplete.

description: Abnormal turnover/volume expansion normalized by market and volatility regime.
prior_failure_addressed: May help separate meaningful participation from weak OHLCV signals, but prior OHLCV-only volume/wick concepts already failed promotion.
required_data_source: Local OHLCV can provide base volume; richer turnover would require quote volume or exchange turnover fields.
minimum_validation_gate: Must be paired with genuinely new data or predeclared normalization; cannot be another immediate OHLCV-only batch; later-data check required.
reason_for_selection: Availability is good but independence from failed OHLCV-only candidates is weak.

description: BTC dominance, alt dominance, or market-share regime data to decide whether basket/alt strategies should be active.
prior_failure_addressed: Autonomous loop could not execute BTC dominance filter because data was missing; may address alt/basket regime mismatch.
required_data_source: External market-cap/dominance source such as CoinMarketCap/CoinGecko/TradingView-compatible historical dominance, with timestamp alignment.
minimum_validation_gate: Data provenance audit, fixed dominance regime rule, no post-result symbol selection, no-trade comparison, basket breadth checks.
reason_for_selection: Potentially useful but requires external data governance before strategy planning.

description: Stablecoin dominance, stablecoin supply/liquidity proxy, or risk-liquidity regime indicator.
prior_failure_addressed: May explain broad risk-on/risk-off conditions that BTC EMA regime failed to capture.
required_data_source: External stablecoin market-cap/dominance history, exchange liquidity proxy, or macro crypto liquidity dataset.
minimum_validation_gate: Predeclared liquidity regime rule, long historical coverage, no post-result regime relabeling, no-trade and passive BTC comparisons.
reason_for_selection: Interesting macro feature, but data sourcing and interpretation risk are higher than funding/OI.

description: Breadth/rotation features across BTC, majors, alts, and families rather than single-symbol signals.
prior_failure_addressed: Weak-market drag and family concentration problems.
required_data_source: Existing OHLCV can compute basic RS; richer breadth may require broader universe beyond 19 symbols.
minimum_validation_gate: Must avoid selecting winners post-result; fixed family/breadth formula, no market removal, BTCUSDT/DOGE/DOT/UNI visible, later-data check.
reason_for_selection: A relative-strength candidate already failed in the autonomous loop; another RS-only path is not sufficiently new without broader data.

description: Classifier for compression, expansion, crash, chop, and rebound regimes.
prior_failure_addressed: Failed transfer across historical and later windows suggests regime mismatch.
required_data_source: Can start from OHLCV, but stronger version should include OI/funding/liquidation/liquidity features.
minimum_validation_gate: Must freeze labels/formula before testing; cannot tune regimes after results; must compare no-trade and passive BTC; later-data required.
reason_for_selection: A pure OHLCV regime filter failed; worthwhile only after new data classes are available.

description: Calendar/news risk filter to block trading around major macro, exchange, regulatory, or asset-specific events.
prior_failure_addressed: Crash/regime failures, stop clusters, and transfer failures may be event-driven rather than technical-pattern driven.
required_data_source: Historical economic calendar, crypto event/news feed, exchange incident calendar, regulatory/news taxonomy; timestamps and severity labels.
minimum_validation_gate: Strict predeclared event taxonomy, no hindsight labeling, no removing losing periods after seeing results, no-trade comparison, later-data/forward observation.
reason_for_selection: Potentially valuable as risk control, but high hindsight-labeling risk means it should not be first.
